DecisionSessionContext.description:
Run calendar context supplied by the platform with a decision request.

When present it is authoritative: ``previous_session_date`` is the run's
previous decision session (``None`` for the run's first session), exactly the
value offline replay takes from its session list. When the whole object is
absent (older callers) the engine derives the previous session from the
market calendar.
DecisionSessionContext.title: DecisionSessionContext

TransitionProposal.description:
Pure numerical proposal. Committed only by the application after checks.

``proposal_hash`` = sha256 of canonical JSON of every field except
``proposal_hash`` and ``signature``; ``signature`` = HMAC over that hash.
TransitionProposal.title: TransitionProposal

info.description: Python research-engine internal API (spec 14.3). Every path requires the X-API-Key header. Errors are application/problem+json. TransitionProposal and StrategyResult bodies carry sha256 hashes over canonical JSON and an HMAC-SHA256 signature with the shared ML_SERVICE_SIGNING_KEY.
info.title: Research engine internal API
